deltas.title_id: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 24 Tahun 2026 — PPN Ditanggung Pemerintah atas Tiket Pesawat
deltas.title_en: Ministry of Finance Regulation No. 24 of 2026 — Government-Borne VAT (DTP) on Airline Tickets
deltas.impact_note: PMK 24/2026 DTP program for airline ticket PPN expires approximately June 20-21, 2026; clients and companies purchasing tickets before deadline avoid the standard 11% PPN liability otherwise passed to the buyer.
deltas.summary: PMK 24/2026 governs the PPN DTP (Pajak Pertambahan Nilai Ditanggung Pemerintah) regime for airline tickets. DDTC article of June 14, 2026 reports the benefit remains accessible until next week, signaling imminent program expiry. No new regulatory amendment issued; this is a deadline-proximity notice.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PPN DTP Tiket Pesawat Masih Bisa Dimanfaatkan hingga Pekan Depan [DDTC article headline, 14 June 2026 — full regulatory text not retrieved from source]
